description: Adds voltage control of the seven envelope knobs on Vega, and goes immediately to the left of it

inputs.text: Adds a tenth of its voltage to the corresponding knob on Vega

notes: unlike most Rack expanders this one goes on the LEFT of the module it expands, because it looks for a Vega on its own right
each jack adds to the Vega knob rather than replacing it, so the knob sets where the control starts from
